observations: Close-up of an internal combustion engine with a visible alternator and pulley system.
The engine block appears to be a 4-cylinder configuration based on the pulley arrangement.
The engine is shown in a disassembled or partially assembled state.
There is visible dirt and grime on the engine components.
A watermark 'NWAKOIA OBEZE' is present across the center of the image.

risks.risk: The engine may be non-functional or have internal mechanical damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the engine running and the alternator producing a charging voltage.

risks.risk: The engine may be missing essential components such as the intake manifold or exhaust manifold.
risks.proof: A photo showing the complete assembly of the engine with all major parts installed.

risks.risk: The engine may have been used in a different vehicle or may be a used engine.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate (VIN or engine number) stamped into the block.

proof_requests: Video of the engine running to confirm it is functional.
Photo of the engine identification plate showing the engine number and specifications.
Photo of the engine with all major components assembled to confirm completeness.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
